meta.name: listing-distribution
meta.description: Gets a product listed where buyers and crawlers look — directories, marketplaces, review sites, comparison pages, and aggregators. Use this to plan a submission push, choose which directories are worth the effort, prepare listing assets, build comparison and alternative pages, or manage presence on review platforms.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品送进买家会逛的目录和比价页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有产品想在更多平台被看到,却不知从哪个目录开始
copy.tagline_en: Get your product listed on directories, marketplaces, and review sites
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product needing exposure across directories and comparison sites.

howto.what: 装上后，当涉及产品上架或推广时，Claude 会按买家实际使用程度教你挑选目录、准备可复用素材、处理评论与差评，并指导写对比/替代页面。
howto.when: 当你说要规划产品提交、挑选目录、准备上架素材等上架相关的事情时触发。

say.text: 帮我把产品按目录值不值得投排序，别只看域名权重。
say.note: Claude 会按真实买家是否使用来评价值不值得投。

say.text: 帮我准备一套上架素材：不同长度的简介、Logo、截图、功能清单和报价。
say.note: Claude 会列出常见上架平台需要的素材清单。

say.text: 有个差评说我功能少，帮我写条具体、不辩解的回复。
say.note: Claude 会给出一段回应草稿，强调针对性回复。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude guides you through product listing and promotion work: choosing directories by real buyer use, preparing reusable assets, handling reviews and complaints, and building comparison/alternative pages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a submission push, pick directories, or prepare listing assets, among other listing work.

say_en.text: Sort where to list my product by real buyer use, not domain authority.
say_en.note: Claude ranks by real buyer use, not authority.

say_en.text: Prepare listing kit: descriptions, logo, screenshots, features, pricing.
say_en.note: Claude lists assets commonly needed for submissions.

say_en.text: A bad review says I miss features; draft a specific, non-defensive reply.
say_en.note: Claude drafts a tailored, non-defensive reply.
